scope: Read-only identity audit of the historical 100 BIDMC linear evaluations (AnyPPG/PaPaGei-S, two tasks, five seeds/folds). No retraining or editing old outputs.
correction: The prior phrase 53 subjects refers to recording groups. Record-level splits are disjoint but physical patients can occur on both sides. Matching published numerical results remains true; these scores do not demonstrate strict unseen-patient generalization.
breath_annotation_index_note: The official MATLAB importer copies ann.resp.breaths.x1/x2 directly into Breaths.csv (lines 842-855) and into RRest ref.breaths (lines 698-700). These signal sample numbers are MATLAB one-based; use (sample-1)/125 for zero-origin time. The constant offset leaves an unchanged interval difference but can change which annotations enter a half-open time window.
